# Solid State Logic

> Solid State Logic (SSL) is the global leader in audio mixing consoles, digital systems, and professional audio solutions for broadcast, music production, live sound, and entertainment.

SSL designs and manufactures industry-standard mixing consoles and audio processing equipment used in recording studios, broadcast facilities, live venues, and post-production environments worldwide. The company offers both hardware consoles and cloud-based audio processing solutions across multiple market segments.

## Key Topics

- Mixing Consoles
- Professional Audio
- Broadcast Production
- Music Production
- Studio Equipment
- Audio Processing
- Digital Consoles
- SuperAnalogue Technology

- Entertainment Audio

## Studio Mixing Consoles

- [Oracle](https://solidstatelogic.com/products/oracle): Oracle future analogue in-line mixing console with ActiveAnalogue technology.
- [ORIGIN Series Consoles](https://solidstatelogic.com/products/origin-series-consoles): ORIGIN and ORIGIN EVO studio consoles for professional facilities.
- [AWS 948 δelta](https://solidstatelogic.com/products/aws): AWS 948 δelta SuperAnalogue console with digital control and DAW integration.
- [Duality Fuse](https://solidstatelogic.com/products/duality-fuse): Duality Fuse industry-standard mixing console for large-scale production.
- [TriniTy Solution](https://solidstatelogic.com/products/trinity): TriniTy SuperAnalogue console combining sound with digital flexibility.

## Broadcast & Live Production Solutions

- [Broadcast Production](https://solidstatelogic.com/solutions/broadcast-production): SSL broadcast production solutions for news, programming, and OTT services.
- [OB & Sports Production](https://solidstatelogic.com/solutions/ob-and-sports-production): SSL broadcast audio solutions for outside broadcast and sports production.
- [Live Touring & Events](https://solidstatelogic.com/solutions/touring-and-events): SSL live series consoles for touring and live event audio production.
- [Entertainment](https://solidstatelogic.com/solutions/entertainment): SSL audio platforms for large-scale entertainment production challenges.

## Music & Content Creation

- [Music Production & Mixing](https://solidstatelogic.com/solutions/music-production-and-mixing): SSL mixing consoles: analogue, digital, and future analogue solutions.
- [Music Creation](https://solidstatelogic.com/solutions/music-creation): SSL professional music creation tools for studio and home production.
- [System T for Music](https://solidstatelogic.com/products/system-t-for-music): System T for Music next-gen platform optimised for immersive music.
- [Audio Post Production](https://solidstatelogic.com/solutions/post-production): SSL tools and solutions for audio post-production challenges.
- [Podcast & Webcast Production](https://solidstatelogic.com/solutions/podcast-and-webcast-production): SSL broadcast-quality audio tools for podcast and webcast production.

## Cloud & Installed Systems

- [Cloud Audio Processing](https://solidstatelogic.com/solutions/audio-cloud-processing): Virtualised DSP and control software for cloud-based audio processing.
- [Installed Sound](https://solidstatelogic.com/solutions/installed-sound): SSL installed sound systems for venues, theaters, and worship houses.
